purpose: General evidence/effect boundary for bank and payment rails while keeping authentication and account secrets outside repository evidence.

execution.prepare: Bind exact debtor/payer role, creditor/payee role, amount, currency, purpose, rail, provider and owner authorization without exposing protected values.
execution.authorize: Use provider/bank-owned strong customer authentication or delegated authorization boundary.
execution.commit: Submit exactly one bound payment instruction unless provider idempotency semantics prove safe replay.
execution.effect_readback: Reobserve provider/bank transaction state and intended resource/economic effect.
execution.persist: Persist non-secret receipt and effect evidence only.
execution.revalidate: Freshly bind evidence to the exact transaction/resource subject.

sepa_specific.credit_transfer: Bind creditor, amount, currency, remittance purpose and provider transaction reference; do not equate accepted instruction with settlement.
sepa_specific.instant_credit_transfer: Require authoritative terminal status/readback; timeout or ambiguous status is HOLD_UNVERIFIED, never blind retry.
sepa_specific.direct_debit: Mandate existence and mandate reference are separate prerequisites; debit initiation does not prove final non-reversible effect.
sepa_specific.refund_return_reversal: Represent as successor transaction/effect, never mutate historical receipt into success.

open_banking_specific.consent: Consent scope, provider and expiry are explicit evidence; credentials remain provider-owned.
open_banking_specific.payment_initiation: PIS authorization is distinct from settlement readback.
open_banking_specific.account_information: AIS data minimization applies; do not persist full account datasets merely to prove a payment effect.
